claims.claim_text: When the unit drops off monitoring, check the feed breaker in the DC panel before starting on the unit itself, since a drop like that is most often a breaker tripped by a short spike. Reset it once, and if it trips a second time don't reset again, that probably means a real fault downstream, so call Risto first.
claims.check_step: look at the feed breaker in the DC panel
claims.do_not_before: don't start on the unit itself before checking the breaker
